title: Circle CVI software or equivalent for VA Portland Healthcare System
description: Combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products and services under RFO 12.212(b)(1). Firm-fixed-price purchase order anticipated, set aside for small businesses (size standard 150 employees). The VA Portland Healthcare System seeks a base year plus two option years of Circle CVI or equivalent software and associated services. Service location: VA Portland Healthcare System, 3710 SW U.S. Veterans Hospital Road, Portland, OR. Base year 12/20/2026 to 12/19/2027, option years through 12/19/2029. Award based on the evaluation factors in Section E of the attached RFQ.
